name: Species-specific sticking, residence time, and re-emission distributions
purpose: Exercise Na and Ar through the linked production impact/desorption dispatch and compare stochastic re-emission distributions with their declared analytic laws.
production_capability: Species-specific sticking, residence time, and re-emission distributions
configuration: Dedicated Config.pl Na,Ar build with RadiogenicArgon registered; derived lola_surface.in with argon_source_enabled=true, unchanged 100 km LOLA surface/physics, and bounded custom volume-ownership targets; 4096 Na samples and 32768 Ar source attempts per MPI rank; eight MPI ranks by default.
inputs: predecessor I13 PASS from the same campaign
Tenishev et al. 2013 Na parameters in the receipt
Kegerreis et al. 2017 Ar parameters in the receipt
Killen 2002 lower-bound source rate in the receipt
independent_reference: Input-parameter Arrhenius residence laws, binomial event-count interval, and closed-form Maxwell energy, Maxwell-flux energy, uniform-hemisphere, and cosine-law CDFs implemented only in the Python scorer.
units: temperature K; speeds m s^-1; source rate atoms s^-1; normalized energies and direction cosines dimensionless
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed geometry, LSO particle state, SPICE TDB internally, archive UTC where supplied
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Base seed 731993 is input-defined; rank seed is base+104729*rank+18; MPI/OpenMP layout and executable hash are recorded.
procedure: Require same-campaign I13 PASS; build and hash the dedicated Na+Ar executable; initialize the normal M2 application; call the production Na impact, Na/Ar thermal-desorption, and Ar source callbacks; preserve row-level samples; score independent analytical rates and CDFs.
metrics: four one-sample KS distances and thresholds
linked Na/Ar desorption rates and relative errors
acceptance_criteria: Exactly 4096 Na rows per MPI rank; aggregate Ar rows equal the linked accepted count and total at least 4096; physical finite bounds; Na count within 1.96*sqrt(sum p_i(1-p_i)); every KS D <= 1.36/sqrt(N); linked Na/Ar desorption rates agree with independent input-law evaluations within 1e-12 relative error; Ar rate equals 3.8e20 atoms s^-1 within 1e-15 relative tolerance.
expected_pass_result: The linked production Na and Ar samplers satisfy every frozen 95% stochastic gate and the declared Ar driver rate.
required_data: No observational package; peer-reviewed parameters are frozen in application.in and cited in its comments
data_hashes: The build receipt hashes the derived Config.pl inputs and executable; run_manifest.json hashes application.in and source/data contracts.
status_semantics: PASS means the full linked criterion ran and passed; FAIL means it ran and missed the criterion; ERROR is infrastructure/parser/corruption; SKIPPED means a prerequisite, capability, configuration, or authoritative input is unavailable.
